finding: The current Product launcher uses the same generic Electron image that executes an unrelated Node fixture; OS PID/start/path and image bytes do not bind the running application to Shaco Product Main.
limitations: Probe proves inadequacy of a path/runtime-file identity policy, not impossibility of every future attestation design
No actual lifecycle credential-issuance channel exists or was exercised
The fixture is distinguishable by arguments/environment; this probe does not test or establish a trusted application binding based on those values
No Shaco-specific packaged executable, approved application-integrity binding or corresponding verifier was found in the inspected Product source and current launch scripts
